# Security at Acme

Security is built into how Acme is designed, built and operated.

## Certifications

Acme maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and is ISO 27001 certified. Reports are available to customers and prospects under NDA.

## Encryption

All data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256.

## Access control

Acme supports role-based access control, so people on your team only see the connections relevant to their work. Workspace owners manage who has access.

## Activity logging

Administrative activity in your workspace is logged and available to workspace owners.

Read more in our [trust center](https://trust.acme.test/).
